select
con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, com.C_Name as cpafConstructionUnitName, mn.* from Con_Pay_Apply_Flow mn
left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company com on mn.Cpaf_Construction_Unit=com.C_ID where mn.Con_id=#{conId} and mn.State=7

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, com.C_Name as cpafConstructionUnitName, com1.C_Name as cpafPayeeName, mn.* from Con_Pay_Apply_Flow mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_ID left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company com on mn.Cpaf_Construction_Unit = com.C_ID left join SYS_Company com1 on mn.Cpaf_Payee = com1.C_ID where Cpaf_Id = #{cpafId}
select cpaf.* from Con_Pay_Apply_Flow cpaf left join Con_Pay_Apply cpa on cpa.Cpa_Id=cpaf.Cpa_Id where cpaf.State=7 and cpa.Cpa_Sources='01' and cpaf.Con_Id=#{conId}

SELECT pre.p_name as pName , con.con_name as conName, con.con_code as conCode, pre.p_id as pId, con.con_id as conId, flow.payljap as payLJAP , flow.Shipping_time as shippingTime, con.con_type as conType, sys.c_name AS conPartyAName , flow.cpaf_payee as cpafPayee, pay.Pay_Id as payId, flow.Cpaf_Create_Uname as cpafCreateUname, pay.pay_Approval as payApproval, flow.cpaf_Application as cpafApplication, flow.cpaf_Apply_Proportion as cpafApplyProportion, flow.cpaf_Remaining_Amount as cpafRemainingAmount, flow.Cpaf_Id as cpafId, flow.cpaf_Create_Uid as cpafCreateUid, flow.cpaf_Create_Time as cpafCreateTime, flow.State as state, flow.State_Time as stateTime, CASE WHEN flow.cpaf_Create_Time = earliest_flow.earliest_create_time THEN pay.pay_Invoice ELSE '-' END AS payInvoice, CASE WHEN flow.cpaf_Create_Time = earliest_flow.earliest_create_time THEN pay.pay_Invoice_No ELSE '-' END AS payInvoiceNo FROM con_pay_apply_flow flow LEFT JOIN pre_project pre ON flow.p_id = pre.P_ID LEFT JOIN con_contract con ON con.con_id = flow.con_id LEFT JOIN sys_company sys ON sys.c_id = con.con_party_a_id LEFT JOIN Con_Pay pay ON pay.pay_id = flow.pay_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cpa_id, MIN(cpaf_Create_Time) AS earliest_create_time FROM con_pay_apply_flow group by cpa_id
) earliest_flow ON pay.pay_id = earliest_flow.cpa_id AND flow.cpaf_Create_Time = earliest_flow.earliest_create_time

select SUM(flow.cpaf_Application) as cpafApplicationSum, SUM(flow.cpaf_Remaining_Amount) as cpafRemainingAmountSum FROM con_pay_apply_flow flow LEFT JOIN pre_project pre ON flow.p_id = pre.P_ID LEFT JOIN con_contract con ON con.con_id = flow.con_id LEFT JOIN sys_company sys ON sys.c_id = con.con_party_a_id

select sum(pay_Approval) from con_pay pay where pay.pay_id in ( select flow.pay_id FROM con_pay_apply_flow flow LEFT JOIN pre_project pre ON flow.p_id = pre.P_ID LEFT JOIN con_contract con ON con.con_id = flow.con_id LEFT JOIN sys_company sys ON sys.c_id = con.con_party_a_id
)
